name: TD IT Solution Insurance Design System

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Logo navy. Wordmark ink, hero and splash grounds, large navy fields. Not body text in the night theme.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Logo blue. Decorative strokes, chart series and large icons on light grounds. Not text: use link or action-secondary.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Logo orange. Primary action fill, highlights and the leading chevron. Carries on-action-primary text, never white text.

tokens.name: brand-blue-bright
tokens.usage: Lighter blue for strokes and icons on navy or night grounds, such as the app icon. 6.8:1 on bg-page in the night theme.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. Ink, ink-muted, link and status colours read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: bg-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the page gradient. Use with bg-bottom; see Backdrop.

tokens.name: bg-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the page gradient.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Solid card or sheet where glass is not wanted, for example forms with long text. Ink reads on it.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Input wells and table stripes. Ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Frosted card fill. Always used with backdrop blur and glass-border. Ink and ink-muted read on it over every backdrop glow.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: One-pixel edge of a glass surface. Decorative; pair it with shadow-glass so the edge still reads in the day theme.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines that carry no meaning.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, checkboxes and other controls. At least 3:1 on bg-page, bg-raised and glass-fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg-page, bg-raised, glass-fill and bg-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions and placeholders on the same grounds as ink.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-navy fields such as the hero and splash.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and informational text on bg-page, bg-raised and glass-fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange used as text or a thin icon: the deep amber in the day theme, brand orange in the night theme. Never brand-orange on a light ground.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button. One per screen.

tokens.name: on-action-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icon on action-primary. 7.8:1.

tokens.name: action-secondary
tokens.usage: Fill of the secondary button and selected controls.

tokens.name: on-action-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icon on action-secondary: white on the day blue, deep navy on the night blue.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Two-pixel solid focus ring with a 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface above.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Protected, recovered, verified. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a success badge. success text reads on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Lost, stolen, error. Always with a word or icon. Differs from success by lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a danger badge. danger text reads on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, expiring, needs attention. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a warning badge. warning text reads on it.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind an info badge. link text reads on it.

tokens.name: glow-blue
tokens.usage: Blue light in the page backdrop. Decorative only; never behind small text without glass-fill.

tokens.name: glow-orange
tokens.usage: Orange light in the page backdrop. Decorative only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero headline and splash taglines. Day or night, ink on bg-page.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Big numbers: premium, cover amount, recovery count.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section gap on tablets.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and small chips inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels and the tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and the primary button on phones.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Resting glass cards and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating elements: tab bar, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for standard glass cards.

tokens.name: blur-glass-strong
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for the tab bar and sheets over busy content.
